clue.text: Succeeding by chance after taking pawn in game

parts.note: P is the chess notation for a pawn
someone who succeeds by chance is fortunate

explanation.surface: A chess player wins by fluke after grabbing a pawn during a match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Game' looks like the chess match, but here it is an adjective meaning brave.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective, game means willing and courageous, the same sense as brave or spirited.

clue.text: Wind instrument as needed in each section, initially, piano coming in at various points

indicators.note: something coming in at several points is slotted inside the other letters more than once
initially points to the opening letter of each of the preceding words

parts.note: first letters of the five words
P is the musical abbreviation for piano (soft), used three times

explanation.surface: Instructions for a wind instrument part, with the piano chiming in at various points in each section.
explanation.walkthrough: The single P for piano goes in three times: before the A, before the I and before the E.
explanation.definitionFit: Panpipes are a row of tubes of graded length blown across the top, so they are a wind instrument.

clue.text: Take part of bun if you make one

indicators.note: taking part of a phrase means lifting out a run of its letters

parts.note: the letters run across the three words

explanation.surface: An invitation to break off some of a bun if you bake one yourself.
explanation.definitionFit: To unify things is to bring them together into a single whole.

clue.text: Making his mark, perhaps, in disputed region of Asia

indicators.note: perhaps suggests a possible version of the words, so they are rearranged

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone making a name for himself in a contested Asian territory.
explanation.definitionFit: Kashmir is a Himalayan region whose sovereignty is contested between India, Pakistan and China.

clue.text: Means to release prisoner Romans maltreated

indicators.note: something maltreated is knocked about, so the letters are roughed up into a new order

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Paying to free a captive who has been abused by Roman soldiers.
explanation.definitionFit: A ransom is the payment demanded for freeing a captive, so it is the means of release.

clue.text: With odd omissions, parroted Italian author's old style

indicators.note: omitting the odd-numbered letters leaves only the even ones

parts.note: the second, fourth, sixth and eighth letters
Umberto Eco, author of The Name of the Rose

explanation.surface: Mocking a famous Italian novelist's dated prose by copying it, minus a few oddities.
explanation.definitionFit: Art Deco is the decorative design movement of the 1920s and 1930s, a style now historic.

clue.text: Oddly, store ain't the kind that has what writer needs

definitions.text: the kind that has what writer needs

indicators.note: doing something oddly means doing it in a strange arrangement, so the letters are reordered

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A shop that oddly turns out not to be the kind selling writing supplies.
explanation.definitionFit: A stationer sells paper, pens and envelopes, the materials someone writing needs.

clue.text: Person navigating Jumbo miles in error about a height

indicators.note: about means going round, so the outer letters wrap the following pair

parts.note: M is the abbreviation for miles
taken as written
H is the abbreviation for height
a guess that is out is mistaken

explanation.surface: A pilot steering a jumbo jet miles off course, too high.
explanation.walkthrough: M and OUT together make the outer shell, with A and H tucked between them. 'Jumbo' suggests a jet but means an elephant.
explanation.definitionFit: A mahout is the keeper and rider who drives an elephant, the jumbo of the clue.

clue.text: Snub idea that's crazy? That's fair

indicators.note: something crazy is disordered, so the letters are thrown into a new order

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Dismissing a wild idea outright is the just thing to do.
explanation.definitionFit: Fair in the sense of impartial, treating everyone without prejudice.

clue.text: Take apart, since concealed by mask

indicators.note: a thing concealed by another sits hidden inside it

parts.note: to mask one's feelings is to disguise them
as can mean because or since

explanation.surface: Dismantling something because it was hidden behind a disguise.
explanation.definitionFit: To disassemble a machine is to dismantle it into its component parts.

clue.text: Worthless paintings returned before retiring

indicators.note: something returned goes back the way it came, so the word is read from the end

parts.note: paintings collectively are art
a retiring person is shy

explanation.surface: Pictures of no value sent back before a gallery closes.
explanation.definitionFit: Trashy describes something of poor quality, cheap and of little value.

clue.text: Piety displayed with no end of care and compassion

indicators.note: with no means lacking, so a letter is taken out

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the end of a word is its final letter

parts.note: the final letter of this word

explanation.surface: Religious devotion shown without much care or kindness.
explanation.walkthrough: The E taken from the end of 'care' is removed from PIETY.
explanation.definitionFit: Pity is the sorrow felt for another's suffering, a synonym of compassion.

clue.text: The writer's in earnest about time creating a puzzle

parts.note: the writer speaking of himself: belonging to me

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the word goes round the single letter

parts.note: someone in earnest is serious
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: An author earnestly setting a puzzle while keeping track of the clock.
explanation.definitionFit: Something mysterious baffles people, so it leaves them with a puzzle to solve.

clue.text: Returned no work — emphasised it's needed for final course

indicators.note: returned means sent back, so everything that follows is read from right to left

parts.note: taken as written
OP is short for opus, a work
to emphasise a word is to stress it

explanation.surface: A rejected piece of homework sent back with a stern underlined note.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole string NO+OP+STRESSED is read backwards in one go.
explanation.definitionFit: A dessertspoon is the mid-sized spoon used to eat pudding, the last course of a meal.

clue.text: Act as Lady Macbeth and somehow speak well

indicators.note: somehow means in some unspecified manner, so the letters are arranged differently

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Advice to an actor playing Lady Macbeth: deliver the lines well.
explanation.definitionFit: In Macbeth, Lady Macbeth famously walks in her sleep, wringing her hands over imagined blood.

clue.text: Stopped running over broadcast that's cast aside

indicators.note: over here means covering, so the outer word goes round the inner one

parts.note: an engine that stops running has died
seed broadcast is scattered, or sown

explanation.surface: A transmission halted, leaving a programme dropped from the schedule.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Broadcast' suggests radio but is the farming sense of scattering seed.
explanation.definitionFit: To disown someone is to reject or repudiate them, so the disowned are cast aside.

clue.text: Fast form of transport put in front of coach

parts.note: to put an idea into words is to express it
to coach an athlete is to train them

explanation.surface: A speedy vehicle placed ahead of a bus.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coach' looks like a vehicle but is the verb to train.
explanation.definitionFit: An express train makes few stops, so it is a quick way of travelling by rail.

clue.text: Salesman's talk on new model

parts.note: patter is a smooth, glib sales pitch
N is the abbreviation for new

explanation.surface: A sales rep's spiel about the latest model.
explanation.definitionFit: A pattern is a template or example to copy, which is a model.

clue.text: We tucked into small meal from European country

indicators.note: tucked into means placed inside, so the first word goes within the others

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for small
taken as written
a dish is a course or meal

explanation.surface: We ate a light meal that came from Scandinavia.
explanation.definitionFit: Swedish describes anything belonging to or coming from Sweden.

clue.text: Gland is not brought up before end of medical

indicators.note: in a down answer, brought up means raised from the bottom, so the words read upwards

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the end of a word is its final letter

parts.note: the final letter of this word

explanation.surface: A doctor's checkup ends without the gland being mentioned.
explanation.definitionFit: The tonsils are lymphoid tissue at the back of the throat, loosely called glands.

clue.text: Welcoming unusual shop with one piece of furniture

indicators.note: something unusual is out of the normal order, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged
I is the Roman numeral one
a table is an item of furniture

explanation.surface: A friendly, quirky store selling a single piece of furniture.
explanation.definitionFit: A hospitable host is friendly and generous to guests, so is welcoming.

clue.text: Captured, as well, chess piece — that cannot be

parts.note: too means also, or as well
the king is the one chess piece that can never be captured; K is its notation

explanation.surface: A chess piece taken too, though by rule it never could be.
explanation.walkthrough: 'That cannot be' refers back to 'Captured': the king is never taken, only checkmated.
explanation.definitionFit: Took is the past tense of take, and in chess to take a piece is to capture it.

clue.text: It's covered by not just any old tax

indicators.note: something covered by another is enclosed by it, so it sits inside

parts.note: the definite article singles out one particular thing, unlike 'a'
taken as written

explanation.surface: A historic levy that applies to some things but not to everything.
explanation.definitionFit: A tithe was a tenth of produce or income paid to support the Church, an old form of tax.

clue.text: Everything person possesses is English, say

parts.note: E is the abbreviation for English
to state something is to say it

explanation.surface: Declaring that all of someone's belongings are English.
explanation.definitionFit: A person's estate is the whole of their property and assets, especially at death.

clue.text: Lives in area, making living

indicators.note: in means placed inside, so the first word sits within the second

parts.note: the extent of something is its area or size
to live is to be, so lives gives is

explanation.surface: Residing in a district is how one earns a living.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Making living' reads like earning money, but 'living' is the adjective meaning alive.
explanation.definitionFit: Existent means having actual existence, so being alive or current.

clue.text: Happy about line I produced with ruler

definitions.note: a phrase that the noun or participle stands for: liking a thing is being happy about it

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for line
taken as written
a king is a ruler

explanation.surface: Pleased with a single line delivered alongside a monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: Liking something means enjoying it or being pleased with it.

clue.text: Protect as beginner at wheel did some throwing outside

indicators.note: outside means going round, so the second word wraps the first

parts.note: to shy a stone is to throw it, so shied means threw
a learner driver displays L plates

explanation.surface: Guarding a novice potter making their first attempts at the wheel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wheel' and 'throwing' suggest pottery, but the beginner is a learner driver at the steering wheel; L plates mark a British learner.
explanation.definitionFit: To shield someone is to screen or guard them from harm.
